function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a given location.

location.description: The city or location to get the weather for, e.g. 'Paris'.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Set a timer for a specified number of minutes with a label.

duration_minutes.description: How long the timer should run, in minutes.

label.description: A short label describing what the timer is for.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a text message to a recipient.

recipient.description: The name or contact of the person to message.

message.description: The text content of the message.

function.name: search_contacts
function.description: Search the user's contacts for people matching a query.

query.description: The search term, e.g. a name or partial name.
